summary: Figure 1D shows three PSC and three htNSC samples alongside the GTEx tissues. Its first two markers, POU5F1 and NANOG, are visibly lower in htNSCs, matching the registered direction. This refutes the proposed no_valid_comparison closure. Only 33 of 37 plotted markers have registered results (89.19%), below the 90% coverage requirement. All five reported computations and all 65 file hashes and sizes reproduced, although the saved GEO landing page is a reCAPTCHA response. [Figure 1D](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/biorxiv/early/2025/03/05/2024.05.23.595504/F1.large.jpg)
openIssues: The heatmap reports z-scores and labels columns by group. Exact sample identities, author fold changes, P values and FDR remain unverified. The Supporting Data Values XLS remains unlocated.
GSM6617218 and GSM6617219 have CMC11 and AG09908R1 titles and corresponding count columns, but both records identify the cell line as H9.
